title: Expose delivery evidence for recovering after a process exits
description:
This covers recovery only. Live delivery reads stdout `command_lifecycle` frames and needs none of it, so wait until devhost builds recovery after a Claude Code process dies.

`agent-parser` keeps a `UUID` field in its Claude Code line struct, but `ParsedEvent` has no field for it. Exposing that alone is not enough, because a sent UUID reaches the transcript in three shapes:

| Case | Where the UUID lands |
| --- | --- |
| Normal turn | `user.uuid` |
| Queued messages merged | The last in `user.uuid`, the others in `mergedSendUuids` |
| Absorbed mid-turn | No `user` record; `queue-operation` `remove` with `commandUuid` and `reason: absorbed_mid_turn` |

Change:
- agent-parser: expose the message UUID and `mergedSendUuids` on `turn_start`, and emit an event for absorbed messages.
- agent-watcher: export `locateTranscript`, because a snapshot does not list a dead session.

`enqueue` and `dequeue` records carry no UUID, so a transcript can prove a message was consumed but not that it was queued. A missing record means unknown.
